title: checkride configuration
description: Schema for checkride.config.json — add it only to deviate from the zero-config defaults.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor validation and autocompletion.

extends.description: Preset(s) to inherit — a file path (./base.json) or package specifier (@acme/preset), or an array of them. Bases merge left-to-right and the local config wins over all; objects deep-merge, arrays and scalars replace (arrays are not concatenated).

timeout.description: Default per-check timeout in seconds. Unset, checks fall back to the built-in 600s cap; 0 here or on a check disables the cap.

checks.description: Per-slot configuration. A key that matches a catalogue slot (types, format, lint, struct, dead, dupes, health, test, docs, links, spell, mutation, security, publint, attw) configures that slot; any other key is a custom check that runs alongside the catalogue. Naming an opt-in slot (format, dupes, health, mutation, security, publint, attw) here also opts it into the default run — set optIn:true on the entry to configure it without opting in (run it only with --all/--include).

slotConfig.description: How to fill a slot: an adapter name, false to disable it, an adapter with overrides, or a custom check.

oneOf.description: Adapter name that fills this slot, beating detection.

useConfig.description: Pick an adapter by name and override individual fields.

use.description: Adapter name to select from the registry.

optIn.description: Override the slot's opt-in status. true configures the slot without opting it into the default run (reach it with --all/--include); false forces it into the default run.

exclude.description: Links slot only: extra directory names to skip while walking for markdown, on top of the built-in exclude set (e.g. docs, research, .ridgeline).

allowlist.description: Links slot only: regex sources for link targets to treat as always valid (deliberately illustrative links that never resolve on disk).

profile.description: attw slot only: append --profile <name> (e.g. esm-only) to the attw invocation — a shortcut for retyping the full args.

order.description: Scheduling order. A number places the check on the ascending wave line (equal numbers run together as one wave; decimals sequence steps within a wave); the keywords place it relative to that line — first/last before/after everything, single exclusively on its own, middle/any unordered in the main group.

customCheck.description: A bare command that needs no adapter.

detect.description: Marker files that gate a non-catalogue custom check: it runs only when at least one listed file exists, and is skipped otherwise. Ignored on an entry that fills a catalogue slot.

optIn.description: true holds this custom check out of the default run — it runs only under --all/--include <name>. Absent runs it by default.
